== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ヴィアーズ将軍</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">オゼル提督と同じ位置にいるなら戦闘力＋1。ホスの同じ位置にいる帝国軍はそれぞれ戦闘力＋1。操縦する戦闘用ビークルの戦闘力に3を加える。「ブリザード1」上では装甲値に1を加え、戦闘運命数が引けない場合にも1枚引ける。</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">マクシミリアン・ヴィアーズ将軍は帝国地上軍将校の模範である。狡猾で忠誠心が強く、敵にとっては致命的までに有能な<u>リーダー</u>。ベイダーの軍団で地上攻撃部隊を指揮する。</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
AI English reading aid (Memory Core ChatGPT, 7 November 2026).

'''Title'''
<blockquote>General Veers</blockquote>

'''Lore'''
<blockquote>General Maximilian Veers is the model of an Imperial Army officer. A cunning and loyal leader, so capable as to be deadly to his enemies. Commands the ground assault troops in Vader's forces.</blockquote>

'''Game text'''
<blockquote>Power +1 if at the same location as Admiral Ozzel. Each Imperial at the same location on Hoth has power +1. Adds 3 to the power of the combat vehicle he pilots. On Blizzard 1, adds 1 to armor and may draw one battle destiny even when unable to draw one otherwise.</blockquote>

The Japanese uses 同じ位置 (“the same location”) in both power bonuses, where the original English specifies “same site” and “same Hoth site.” Its lore describes Veers as deadly efficient against his enemies rather than using the English “ruthlessly efficient.” The original English statistics bar says “FORCE-ATTUNED”; the Japanese bar prints power 3 and ability 3 but leaves the corresponding label area blank.<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Hoth-D-generalveers-decipher-archive.gif|Original English card face]].</ref>

== Rules ==
The November 1998 [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] states that English is the standard for tournament play, directing foreign-language cards and rules to be played and interpreted as their English counterparts under current rulings, errata and clarifications.<ref name="foreign-language-rule">[[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), p. 62, Foreign-language cards and rules.</ref>
